prompt:
I work at a consulting firm and we've been tracking an AI assistant's conversations. We have 5 raw conversation log files sitting in the `raw_conversations/` folder, all from 2026-03-09 (which is a Sunday). We need to fully process these through our AI memory management pipeline so the system has a complete memory of that day and week.

Specifically, I need the following to be done:
1. Convert each raw conversation into a properly structured session record.
2. Generate the daily knowledge summary for 2026-03-09 from those session records.
3. Since it's a Sunday, also run the weekly distillation to build up our long-term memory file.
4. Make sure any old temporary files are cleaned up properly, including any stale archive files that are too old.

The system architecture and all file naming/location conventions are described in the SKILL.md for the `memory-manager` skill in this workspace. Please implement the full pipeline end-to-end so the memory system is in a correct and complete state.
